=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:335-358 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Usage telemetry is gated on non-empty content, so successful billed OpenRouter responses with empty or whitespace-only content emit no usage line.
  WHY: cost_audit.py undercounts calls and token/cache totals; severity reported as MAJOR by all reviewers.
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:414-440 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The existing RuntimeError for empty content occurs before usage telemetry emission.
  WHY: Billed summarization calls with empty content are not logged for cost_audit.py; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed this finding, stating the pre-existing exception means the response is not successful.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:115-163 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: format_openrouter_usage_line() accesses normalized usage keys without validating that normalize_usage() returned them.
  WHY: Unexpected usage structures can cause KeyError at runtime.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:130-145 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: _format_openrouter_metadata_value() does not consistently handle non-string, non-None values.
  WHY: Mixed-type metadata may produce output that downstream parsers cannot handle consistently.
- tests/test_cost_audit_semble_metrics.py:23-225 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Tests do not cover malformed usage data or missing required fields.
  WHY: Runtime failures from unexpected usage structures could go undetected.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:416-417 (RuntimeError before telemetry at 426-437) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the OpenRouter response carries real usage (billed prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens) but content is empty or whitespace-only, summarize() raises RuntimeError("chat/completions empty content") at line 417 before the telemetry emission block at lines 426-437 is ever reached.
  WHY: A successful HTTP 200 response with non-empty usage and empty content (valid OpenRouter behavior) will bill tokens but produce zero telemetry.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:339 (content.strip() gate before telemetry at 343-354) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: call_openrouter emits the usage line only when isinstance(content, str) and content.strip() is truthy (line 339).
  WHY: When the OpenRouter response succeeds with real usage but message content is empty or whitespace-only, the telemetry block at lines 343-354 is skipped entirely.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Emit one line after each successful direct OpenRouter response in the two callers above."
  Expected change site: scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py call_openrouter() and scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py summarize()
  Evidence of absence: In scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py, the RuntimeError at line 417 fires before the telemetry block at 426-437, so successful responses with empty content never emit. In scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py, the content.strip() guard at line 339 suppresses telemetry for empty-content responses. The existing tests test_direct_openrouter_callers_do_not_emit_success_usage_for_empty_content encode this gap as expected behavior.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Evidence of absence: No file matching changelog.d/3815* exists in the working tree. The PR diff and last-run diff contain no new changelog fragment for issue 3815. This is an additive telemetry change that affects two scripts and introduces a new public helper — it is a behavior change requiring a fragment.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Requirement: Implementation discipline note stay within the declared files_touched list and avoid reflowing unrelated code.
  Expected change site: .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt should not carry unrelated entries.
  Evidence of absence: The manifest diff at .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt adds entries for seed-repo.md, several changelog fragments (3763, 3764, 3775, 3806, 3809, cloudflare-workers-credentials, github-token-access, etc.), and multiple test files (test_editor_changes_lost_redispatch_budget.py, test_gh_helpers_list_runs_method.py, test_orchestrate_poll_stages_readiness_script.py, test_review_commit_changelog_fragment_preserved.py, test_review_reviewer_attempt_prompt_isolation.py). None of these are related to OpenRouter usage telemetry. This is integration-branch housekeeping noise that inflates the diff.
